text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe had something she wanted to 
accomplish on the stage of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First: Running at the very front of her 
peers, to see what kind of future lies 
ahead of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Number two. In order to stand at the top— 
I want to win together with my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final destination of this long, long 
journey is just ahead. Let us give Neo 
Universe a grand and glorious welcome 
home.
